description.en:
Opens a music track (BGM) on the BGM channel and returns its handle. The track is not started: wait with CMND_SND_IS_LOADING, then start it with CMND_SND_PLAY.
The optional second argument is passed to the BGM open call with the name; the scripts pass 0 or 30 and its effect was not traced. The optional third argument is the position to start from, as returned by CMND_SND_GET_POS_BGM; the ev_main helper OpenBgmHistory uses it to resume a saved track.
If the track cannot be opened, the function returns the handle of the BGM already playing (0 if none).
Sound handles are integers. Streams opened with the CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands (BGM, event sounds, voices, Special Move sounds, map ambience) get a handle that refers to a stream channel. CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE returns a packed number that names a sound effect instead.
Track name, e.g. "M_08", or the map's default from CMND_SND_GET_DEF_BGMID().
16-bit value passed to the open call (0 or 30 in the scripts).
Position to start from, as given by CMND_SND_GET_POS_BGM.

Handle of the opened track, or of the BGM already playing if the open failed.
0 if the name is missing.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
